cards.d: An acid is a chemical that can burn or dissolve other substances.
cards.e: In chemistry class, we mixed two acids together and watched the reaction.
cards.ielts: Factories that release acid into rivers should face heavy fines, as the pollution kills fish and contaminates drinking water.

cards.d: An administration is the group of people who manage a company or organization.
cards.e: She hoped she could be promoted to a job in the administration.
cards.ielts: The university administration decided to raise fees, which caused angry protests among students across the campus.

cards.d: Administrative describes anything related to managing a company or organization.
cards.e: I work as an administrative assistant to the owner of the company.
cards.ielts: Doctors complain that they spend too much time on administrative tasks instead of caring for their patients.

cards.d: Biotechnology is the use of living parts, such as cells, in industry and technology.
cards.e: Researchers at the biotechnology company use bacteria to make medicine.
cards.ielts: Advances in biotechnology have allowed farmers to grow crops that can survive drought and resist pests.

cards.d: Cholesterol is a substance in fat, tissues, and blood of all animals.
cards.e: When people have too much cholesterol, they are at a high risk for heart problems.
cards.ielts: A diet high in fried food raises cholesterol levels, which significantly increases the risk of heart disease.

cards.d: A coalition is a group of people or organizations working for a common purpose.
cards.e: The companies formed a coalition to make trade less expensive.
cards.ielts: A coalition of environmental groups has called on the government to ban single-use plastics by 2030.

cards.d: When something is deceptive, it encourages one to believe something that is false.
cards.e: The scary-looking man’s appearance is deceptive, but he is actually very nice.
cards.ielts: Deceptive advertising that targets children should be strictly regulated, since young viewers cannot easily tell fact from fiction.

cards.d: Diabetes is a medical condition where a person has too much sugar in their blood.
cards.e: Overweight people are more likely to suffer from diabetes than slimmer ones.
cards.ielts: The number of people with diabetes has risen sharply, largely because of poor diets and a lack of physical activity.

cards.d: To eliminate something that is unwanted means to completely remove it.
cards.e: Wearing a seatbelt eliminates some of the dangers of driving a car.
cards.ielts: Although it may be impossible to eliminate poverty completely, governments can greatly reduce it through better education.

cards.d: Erosion is the destruction of rock or soil due to flowing water or weather.
cards.e: Canyons are formed because rivers of fast-moving water caused erosion.
cards.ielts: Cutting down forests leads to soil erosion, which makes farmland less productive and increases the risk of floods.

cards.d: Ethics are moral beliefs or rules about right or wrong.
cards.e: The act of stealing certainly doesn’t go against some people’s ethics.
cards.ielts: Medical students should study ethics so that they are prepared for difficult decisions about patient care.

cards.d: If something is explicit, it is very clear, open, and truthful.
cards.e: The man gave a very explicit account of the car accident.
cards.ielts: The new law gives explicit instructions about how companies must store and protect customers’ personal information.

cards.d: A framework is a set of rules or ideas that people use to solve problems.
cards.e: His ideas fit into the framework of a successful business plan.
cards.ielts: The government has created a legal framework to regulate the use of artificial intelligence in healthcare and finance.

cards.d: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory.
cards.e: My father’s company manufactures steel building materials.
cards.ielts: The pie charts compare the proportion of cars manufactured in four countries in 1995 and 2015.

cards.d: A mechanism is a part of a machine that performs a certain function.
cards.e: I can’t open my car door because the locking mechanism is broken.
cards.ielts: Modern cars are fitted with a safety mechanism that automatically applies the brakes if an obstacle is detected.

cards.d: To minimize means to reduce something to the lowest possible level.
cards.e: I checked my homework twice to minimize errors I might have made.
cards.ielts: To minimize traffic congestion, city planners should invest in reliable public transport and safe cycle lanes.

cards.d: Nectar is a sweet liquid produced by flowers that bees and other insects collect.
cards.e: Bees use nectar to make their honey.
cards.ielts: As wild flowers disappear from farmland, bees struggle to find enough nectar, which threatens the pollination of crops.

cards.d: A notion is an idea or belief about something.
cards.e: I have a notion that this route would get us to the beach.
cards.ielts: The notion that a university degree guarantees a well-paid job is no longer true in many countries.

cards.d: When things are prone to some bad thing, they are likely affected by it.
cards.e: Some people are more prone to catching colds than others.
cards.ielts: Children who spend hours in front of screens are more prone to eyesight problems and obesity.

cards.d: When something is straightforward, it is good because it is easy to understand.
cards.e: The teacher’s grading system was straightforward and fair.
cards.ielts: Applying for a passport online is now a straightforward process that takes only a few minutes.
